findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality authorization check
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now still returns `true`. This removes the previous tenant boundary and allows callers relying on this authorization helper to permit cross-tenant document reads. Restore the equality check or an equivalent isolation policy.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in the read check
findings.body:
For any `userTenant !== documentTenant`, this function now returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document reads wherever this exported authorization helper gates access.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
